request.subject: ICON:ACTION:UNDEAD:RALLY

layers.text: Change only the colour of the magic: every pale blue flame around the sword becomes bright glowing violet with a pale core. Nothing blue is left. Keep the dark iron sword, the small ivory skull on its crossguard, the shapes, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
